company.name: NimbleRx
company.shortDescription: Nimble provides a pharmacy experience centered around the patient's needs to provide a more streamlined workflow.
company.description: Provider of on demand drug delivery platform intended to create a better experience for patients at a lower price. Nimble partners with pharmacies nationwide to provide prescription delivery, as well as a mobile app for patients to manage and review prescriptions/orders from their phone.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates with pharmacy management systems to streamline prescription refills, orders, payments, and patient communications.
productsAndServices.name: Nimble Pharmacy Platform

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that allows patients to securely manage, order, pay for, and receive prescriptions with options for delivery or in-store pickup.
productsAndServices.name: Nimble Patient App

productsAndServices.description: Services that ensure seamless integration of Nimble’s platform with existing pharmacy systems while maintaining regulatory compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Pharmacy Integration and Compliance Services

productsAndServices.description: Custom-built solutions for Life Science companies to improve patient adherence, reduce prescription abandonment, and target patients effectively using real-time data.
productsAndServices.name: Life Science Partner Solutions

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $14,749,877, or 19.7% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,394,943 to $218,024,177, a 156.3x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-22).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
